items.title: Mastodon – “In The Ruins”
items.summary: In a couple of weeks, Atlanta metal titans Mastodon will return with Marrow Deep, their first album since the sudden, recent death of former member Brent Hinds. We've already posted early singles "Your Ghost Again" and the Josh Homme collab "Snakes For Dinner," and the album also has contributions from members of Gojira, Clutch, Converge, and Lamb Of God, as well as Black Sabbath legend Geezer Butler.
